Is there any reason not to treat marriage as a standard contract? There's no reason three companies can't enter into a contract together, as far as I know, so why is marriage special?

Benefits/tax breaks from the government is why. Spousal benefits and tax breaks are based on one spouse, so having multiple spouses would potentially allow people to cheat the system (in the same way that some women cheat the system by having more children to get more welfare).

Allow people to sign a waiver regarding the government benefits/tax breaks and there'd be no monetary reason for the government to stand in the way of polygamy. All that would be remaining would be getting over hurdle of the moral issue of polygamy (personally I don't give a fuck, but I know plenty of people do).

Personally I just feel like the government should get out of marriage all together. Every marriage is now a civil union and is only recognized for tax purposes/benefits/child custody/estates/etc. Marriage is now the exclusive purview of religion.
